paragraphs.text: Traken is an inquisitor lieutenant of the Church of Avacyn on the plane of Innistrad .

Lieutenant Traken is a dedicated and experienced inquisitor, with a strong sense of duty and urgency. His personality is marked by frustration and desperation due to the worsening crisis. He is proactive, persistent, and unafraid to speak bluntly about the dire situation. His correspondence reveals a man deeply committed to protecting his parish and the city of Thraben , willing to push against bureaucratic inertia to get the necessary action.

Lieutenant Traken was one of the first to recognize the severity of the zombie infestation orchestrated by Gisa and Geralf . He repeatedly informed Bishop Alwin about the escalating threat, particularly the devastation caused by Grimgrin . Despite his warnings, Alwin's reluctance to act forced Traken to continue his efforts under increasingly desperate conditions. He documented the collapse of villages, the massacre of parish residents, and the failures of the city's defenses. As the undead forces neared Thraben, Traken worked under Thalia 's orders, although he questioned her tactics. His notes reflect a sense of resignation and frustration as the situation deteriorated. Ultimately, Traken was involved in the city's defense during the siege, witnessing firsthand the catastrophic breach of the gates and the ensuing chaos.
It is unknown if Traken survived the siege.
